turns.user_utterance: My beneficiary is not allowed, please may I have answer as to why this is?
turns.assistant_response: Thanks for your question—when a beneficiary is marked as “not allowed,” it’s usually due to compliance checks or restrictions on that specific beneficiary details (such as bank account/region, name mismatch, or unsupported beneficiary type). Can you tell me whether you’re trying to add the beneficiary for a bank transfer or the transfer failed after you selected them?
